         120 ms. If the two pipelines operate independently and concurrently, ignoring fusion
           delay, what is the approximate time (in ms) until both are available?
originalSourceText:
Q.2   Suppose facial emotion estimation requires 80 ms while speech processing requires
         120 ms. If the two pipelines operate independently and concurrently, ignoring fusion
           delay, what is the approximate time (in ms) until both are available?

         (A) 40

          (B) 80

          (C) 120

         (D) 200

          Explanation:  With  concurrent  processing,  the  combined  availability  time  is
          determined by the slower pipeline: max(80,120) = 120 ms.
